requirements.description: Authenticated demo roles and server-enforced role boundaries
Distinct navigation for Courses, Assessments, Attempts, Gradebook, Audit
Same-origin Node/Express server, SQLite persistence, health route, and offline browser runtime

As Nora, confirm A-01 is available and the in-progress attempt reflects 60 minutes because of extra time. As Ben, confirm the effective deadline includes his 60-minute extension. Draft A-02 must remain hidden from students.

Save an answer on the signed-in student's active attempt, submit it, and confirm the state is terminal and objective points come from the stored key. Attempts at or after expiry must reject answer changes.
As the assigned Teaching assistant, grade an allowed rubric criterion within its maximum; reject over-maximum values and inaccessible submissions. Confirm a student cannot call grading behavior.

As Instructor, publish a valid draft assessment and release a graded result. Confirm publishing/releasing is unavailable to the Teaching assistant and released feedback becomes visible only to its student and is immutable.
Accepted mutations survive reload and reauthentication without duplication
Responsive, accessible, legible interface with clear interaction feedback
